description: Implementation of socket operations for QUIC protocol, including socket creation, configuration, acceptance, data transmission, and error handling, specific to POSIX systems.

classes.name: AcceptResult
classes.description: Structure holding accepted socket file descriptor and peer address.

classes.name: QuicSocketAddress
classes.description: Class representing a QUIC socket address with address family and generic address.

classes.name: SocketFd
classes.description: Type alias for socket file descriptor.

methods.name: ToPlatformSocketType
methods.description: Converts custom SocketProtocol enum to platform-specific socket type.

methods.name: ToPlatformProtocol
methods.description: Converts custom SocketProtocol enum to platform-specific protocol number.

methods.name: ToStatus
methods.description: Converts errno to absl::Status, mapping certain error numbers to Unavailable or NotFound.

methods.name: SetSocketFlags
methods.description: Sets socket file descriptor flags using fcntl.

methods.name: ValidateAndConvertAddress
methods.description: Validates sockaddr_storage and converts to QuicSocketAddress.

methods.name: CreateSocketWithFlags
methods.description: Creates a socket with specified address family, protocol, and flags.

methods.name: AcceptInternal
methods.description: Accepts a connection on a socket and returns the new socket and peer address.

methods.name: AcceptWithFlags
methods.description: Accepts a connection with specific flags (if supported).

methods.name: GetAddrlen
methods.description: Returns sockaddr length based on IP family.

methods.name: SetSockOptInt
methods.description: Sets socket options for buffer sizes.

methods.name: CreateSocket
methods.description: Creates a socket, optionally non-blocking.

methods.name: SetSocketBlocking
methods.description: Sets socket blocking or non-blocking mode.

methods.name: SetReceiveBufferSize
methods.description: Sets receive buffer size for socket.

methods.name: SetSendBufferSize
methods.description: Sets send buffer size for socket.

methods.name: Connect
methods.description: Connects socket to a peer address.

methods.name: GetSocketError
methods.description: Retrieves socket error status.

methods.name: Bind
methods.description: Binds socket to a local address.

methods.name: GetSocketAddress
methods.description: Retrieves the local address of a socket.

methods.name: Listen
methods.description: Marks socket as listening with specified backlog.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts incoming connection, with optional non-blocking setup.

methods.name: Receive
methods.description: Receives data from socket into buffer, with optional peek.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends data over socket.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes socket file descriptor.
